verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is itself Google's official CLI. It is published in the google-gemini GitHub org and documented on developers.google.com, and it supports AI-native automation: non-interactive scripting, JSON and stream-JSON output, MCP extensibility, and model selection. Community comments suggest it may be sunset in favor of another product, which lowers confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: first-party confirmation of the CLI's ongoing support status, and independent hands-on corroboration of the scripting/structured-output workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation
use the `--output-format json` flag to get structured output
use `--output-format stream-json` to get newline-delimited JSON events
The Gemini CLI is available without additional setup in Cloud Shell
